content:
Recently in backend code changes related to the support of the "Car Key" feature for vehicles from GWM's Tank brand, Apple appears to be preparing to expand this feature to another brand under the same automaker. Here are the details.

According to reports, the "Car Key" feature in Apple Wallet will soon support Haval vehicles.

A few weeks ago, Apple added related code on the backend, showing that vehicles from GWM's Tank brand will soon support the "Car Key" feature in Apple Wallet, allowing users to lock, unlock, and start compatible car models via iPhone or Apple Watch.

Now, as discovered by Aaron Perris on platform X, another brand under the same Chinese automaker, Haval, has also appeared with similar code references:

Although several models under GWM Haval already offer CarPlay, currently none of them support Apple's standalone "Car Key" feature.

After the new feature launches, compatible Haval models will join the ranks of more than 50 car models that currently support the "Car Key" feature, including vehicles from brands such as BMW, Mercedes-Benz, Hyundai, Kia, Genesis, Toyota, and Rivian.
